$comment: THE single source of truth for every Clippy (-D warnings) permutation that gates the #1357 unwrap_used/expect_used denies (#1368). Run locally with `make clippy-matrix` (or `node scripts/clippy-matrix.mjs run --job <job>|--id <id>`); ci.yml invokes the SAME runner per required job and contains no `cargo clippy` of its own. scripts/clippy-matrix.test.mjs (run in the required engine-wasm-ffi-dist job) fails when a production crate, a declared cargo feature, or a #[cfg]/#[cfg_attr] predicate (feature x target_arch x target_os, incl. not(...)) exists that no entry compiles, or when an entry's job is not a required check. `job` = the ci.yml job key; `target` = `host` (the ubuntu x86_64 CI runner) or a rustc triple; `scope` = `lib` (--lib) or `all-targets`; `xwin` = run via `cargo xwin clippy` (cross-checks an MSVC target from the Linux runner; cargo-xwin supplies the Windows CRT/SDK headers C build scripts need, #1372); `wasmCc` = needs the LLVM wasm32 C toolchain env from scripts/wasm-cc-env.sh; `env` = extra env vars for the run. `unlintedCfg` is the explicit, count-ratcheted list of #[cfg] sites no permutation can compile (each with a reason / tracking issue); the guard fails on new sites, higher counts, or stale entries.

entries.why: serde is REQUIRED (the golden_serde_drift guard #1069 only exists under it); ffi lints src/ffi.rs, which no other crate selects.
the lean console/Bojtos package surface (default features).
all(feature = "read-model", target_arch = "wasm32") — the /readmodel package surface. --lib: the read-model test modules are host-only (they run in the engine-wasm-read-model job).
all(feature = "read-model", not(target_arch = "wasm32")) plus the read-model test modules.
default `native` backend (the server's). Clippy never lints path deps, so read-model needs its own runs.
all(feature = "wasm", not(feature = "native")) + wasm32-only paths. --lib: the #[cfg(test)] suites call native-only methods.
links a prebuilt DuckDB; `duckdb-bundled` only forwards to duckdb/bundled (no cfg in processos source — see exemptFeatures).
the Windows-only not(unix) code (#1372): the Windows binaries ship (publish-processos-binaries.yml), so that code is linted, not frozen. Cross-checked from Linux via cargo-xwin (check only, no link).
every server workspace crate with every feature on (console, console-observe, heapprof, test-hooks). Needs `make generate` + a console/dist stub.
not(feature = "console") / not(feature = "console-observe") / not(feature = "heapprof") code — the headless gateway build.

the Windows-only cfg(windows) / not(unix) / target_env = "msvc" code (#1372) with every feature on; the Windows binaries ship (publish-c8ctl-binaries.yml). Cross-checked from Linux via cargo-xwin. Needs `make generate` + a console/dist stub.
the headless (not(feature = "console")) build on Windows (#1372), cross-checked via cargo-xwin.

not(feature = "console") code in nano-server-runtime: in every workspace run nano-server-console's dependency forces `console` on (Cargo feature unification), so only an isolated package run compiles it off.

not(feature = "console") code in nano-server-storage: in every workspace run nano-server-console's dependency forces `console` on (Cargo feature unification), so only an isolated package run compiles it off.

not(feature = "test-hooks") code in nano-falcon-protocol: the gateway binary's dev-dependencies force `test-hooks` on (Cargo feature unification) in every workspace run, so only an isolated package run compiles the production (test-hooks-off) path.

excludedCrates.load-testing/rust-worker: load-test harness, not shipped; not in any production build.
excludedCrates.third_party/openraft-0.9.24: vendored upstream source (patched dependency), not our code.
excludedCrates.third_party/proc-macro-error2-2.0.1: vendored upstream source (patched dependency), not our code.

processos.duckdb-bundled: dependency forwarding only (duckdb/bundled); no #[cfg(feature)] in processos source, so it compiles no distinct processos code.

unlintedCfg.reason: guards a compile_error! (no backend selected); there is no code to lint and no valid build reaches it.
fallback for targets that are neither Unix nor Windows: no shipped binary targets one (publish-*-binaries.yml ships Linux, macOS, Windows), so no valid build reaches it.

registers the e2e harness's pre-main inherited-pipe closer in the Mach-O __mod_init_func section; only an Apple target compiles it and the clippy matrix runs on the Linux CI runner (the sibling not(apple) .init_array arm is linted there).

gates the Kani proof harnesses (kani_proofs.rs), which reference the `kani` crate that only `cargo kani` injects; plain cargo clippy cannot compile them. They are compiled and checked by the non-gating nightly `.github/workflows/kani-nightly.yml` (formal/kani/check.sh).
